label: LongBench v2
description: Long-context multiple-choice benchmark requiring tokenizer-aware eligibility and explicit protocol variants.

governance.decision_notes: Dataset-card and repository license claims cover different surfaces, and constituent long-document rights require review.

license.review_notes: Do not infer rights for embedded books, documents, or code from the dataset-card or repository-level claim.

official_comparability.notes: Only a full, untruncated, tokenizer-eligible protocol with pinned extraction and aggregation parity may claim overall comparability.

blockers: Human review has not resolved dataset-card, repository, and constituent-content rights.
No immutable upstream dataset or runner revision is pinned.
Artifact URL, format, SHA-256, byte count, and size limit are not pinned.
Converter, splits, prompt version, and optional dependency are not fixed.
Tokenizer-aware context eligibility, budget policy, and official runner parity are not established.
